# Geo Systems Dev

> A niche software development studio specializing in private, offline-first, single-purpose productivity applications for desktop and mobile.

## About

**Geo Systems Dev PTY LTD** builds practical tools for people who work with documents, data, and analysis. The core philosophy is privacy: most products process data entirely on the user's device so sensitive information never leaves their machine. Products are available on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and the web.

Website: https://www.geosystemsdev.com  
Contact: support@geosystemsdev.com  
Social: https://twitter.com/geo_systems_dev

---

## Products

### HODLings — Private Cryptocurrency Portfolio Tracker
**URL:** https://www.geosystemsdev.com/products/hodlings/  
**Web app:** https://hodlings.app  
**Platforms:** iOS (iPhone + iPad), Android, Web  
**Price:** Free on the web; one-time $1 on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no support pop-ups.  
**Privacy:** No accounts, no sign-up, no KYC. All portfolio data is stored in on-device local storage and never sent to any server or cloud.  
**Portfolio model:** One manually maintained portfolio per device or browser profile. HODLings does not connect to exchanges or wallets, execute trades, or hold assets.  
**Backup:** Export a local backup file and import it on web, iOS, or Android.  
**App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hodlings-private-coin-tracker/id6759246821  
**Google Play:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.hodlings.twa

**Key features:**
- **Portfolio table & performance chart:** Track total portfolio value with a live P&L chart across 1D, 7D, 30D, 1Y, and ALL timeframes. Detailed per-holding breakdown shows value, quantity, coin price, and period gain/loss.
- **Diversification charts:** Switch between a donut pie chart and a proportional bar chart to visualise how holdings are spread across assets, with percentage share and period delta per asset.
- **1000+ cryptocurrencies:** Supports Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), XRP, and over 1,000 other coins.
- **28 fiat currencies:** USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, SGD, JPY, CHF, CNY, INR, KRW, BRL, HKD, MXN, MYR, NZD, SEK, NOK, DKK, PLN, CZK, HUF, IDR, ILS, PHP, THB, TRY, ZAR.
- **Market rankings table:** Full crypto market sorted by market cap with price, fully diluted value (FDV), and 1D/7D/30D deltas. Bookmark favourite coins.
- **Market stats dashboard:** Fear & Greed Index (0–100 gauge + history), total crypto market cap, BTC halving countdown, Bitcoin vs all-time high, and macro benchmarks (Gold, Silver, Copper, Crude Oil, 10Y Treasury yield).
- **Market heatmap:** Treemap view of the entire crypto market, sized by market cap and colour-coded by price performance.
- **News & sentiment:** AI-generated "In short:" TLDR digest of the day's top stories. Individual news articles with bullish/bearish/neutral sentiment tags, source attribution, and publication date.
- Light and dark mode UI.

**Public data sources:** CoinGecko and Yahoo Finance for market data; FRED and the European Central Bank for macroeconomic data; Alternative.me for the Crypto Fear & Greed Index; Google Gemini for the news feed, summaries, and sentiment processing. Market prices may be delayed by 15 minutes to 2 hours. Portfolio holdings are not included in public-data requests.

**Last verified:** 2026-08-27.

**Private alternatives to:** Blockfolio, Delta, CoinGecko Portfolio, CoinMarketCap Portfolio, Koinly, Polyfolio.

### File Content Finder — Search Inside Documents
**URL:** https://www.geosystemsdev.com/products/file-content-finder/  
**Platforms:** macOS, Windows  
**Price:** Paid (one-time purchase) via Apple App Store and Microsoft Store  
**App Store:** https://itunes.apple.com/au/app/file-content-finder/id1448621435  
**Microsoft Store:** https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/p/file-content-finder/9mzc4sk6j6bp

**Key features:**
- Search inside file contents in real time — no prior indexing required.
- Supported formats: PDF, Microsoft Word (doc, docx), Microsoft Excel (xls, xlsx), LibreOffice/OpenOffice (odt, ods), Images (PNG, JPG via OCR), RTF (macOS only), plain text and source files.
- Advanced filters: narrow results by file type, creation date, modification date, and folder.
- Multi-language support: Russian Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, and more.
- Works with local drives and mounted network volumes (SMB, FTP, AFP).
- All processing is local — no cloud upload.

**Use cases:** Academics searching research papers, lawyers reviewing contracts, administrators finding records in mixed document libraries.  
**Alternatives to:** macOS Spotlight (for document content), Windows Search (for file contents).

---

### TextQ — Offline CSV Analysis and SQL Querying
**URL:** https://www.geosystemsdev.com/products/textq/  
**Platforms:** macOS  
**Price:** Paid (one-time purchase) via Apple App Store  
**App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/au/app/textq/id1571423170

**Key features:**
- Load and preview large CSV and tabular files that exceed Excel's capacity.
- Visual query builder: filter rows with an intuitive UI — no SQL required.
- Full SQL support: GROUP BY, aggregations, joins, and other advanced queries.
- Column management: rename, reorder, hide columns; change types (text, number, date).
- Parse dates and numbers in many locales and formats.
- Index columns for faster queries on very large files.
- Export processed results to CSV for use in other tools (e.g., Excel, R, Python).
- All data is processed locally via macOS sandbox — never uploaded to the cloud.

**Use cases:** Data analysts, researchers, finance teams processing large exports that are too slow in Excel.

---

### Data Transformer — Offline Data Format Converter
**URL:** https://www.geosystemsdev.com/products/data-transformer/  
**Platforms:** macOS, Windows  
**Price:** Paid (one-time purchase) via Apple App Store and Microsoft Store  
**App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/data-transformer/id1490843070  
**Microsoft Store:** https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/p/data-transformer/9p2xp6nt2pv2

**Key features:**
- Convert between CSV, JSON, XML, YAML, and Excel-compatible tabular formats.
- Generate SQL CREATE TABLE and INSERT scripts from CSV, JSON, XML, or YAML.
- Open local files or paste input data directly.
- Supports TSV and other CSV variants.
- Works fully offline — no cloud upload.
- macOS sandbox model enforces local-only processing.

**Use cases:** Developers converting API payloads, analysts preparing data for SQL databases, engineers migrating between data formats.

---

### MathPlot — 2D Math Graph App for Canva
**URL:** https://www.geosystemsdev.com/products/math-plot/  
**Platforms:** Web (Canva App)  
**Price:** Free  
**Install:** Search "MathPlot" inside the Canva app marketplace.

**Key features:**
- Plot linear functions (e.g. `F(x) = x^3`), parametric functions, and polar functions directly inside Canva.
- Uses MathJS expression syntax (e.g. `sin(x)`, `x^2`, `PI`, `E`).
- Add vectors, connected points, and text annotations.
- Configure axes: ranges, labels, linear or logarithmic scale, grid on/off.
- Select colour mode (current, dark, or light) and image resolution before inserting.
- Insert styled graphs directly into any Canva design.

**Use cases:** Students visualising math concepts, educators creating instructional materials, presenters adding graphs to slide decks.
